references.text: Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Israel, who alone does great wonders.
The Lord's mercy and his mighty acts for the house of Israel, which he has shown them according to his compassion and great kindness.
She will give birth to a son, and you shall name him Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins.
Mary's song of praise, which also reflects God's intervention and salvation for Israel.
Because of the tender mercy of our God, the sunrise from on high will visit us.
